## Jira

Jira issue: `ABC-123`

The pull request title must contain the same Jira key. GitHub will turn a configured key into a clickable link, and the `Jira ticket` check will prove that the issue exists.

If the check fails:

1. Add or correct the uppercase Jira key in the title.
2. Confirm that the issue exists and is visible to the configured Jira identity.
3. Re-run the check after Jira rate limits or an outage clears.
